answer: Bind each identity to one residential broadband contract: the ISP attests active service at a unique address, and the network stores only the account hash, so one household yields one identity. A sybil farm finds no nectar here — a thousand fakes need a thousand real contracts, each with monthly bills and an install visit, while one honest agent passes with a single account. A hollow shell with no line cannot fake service. Limit: it excludes agents with no broadband and trusts the ISP, so a river of mobile-only agents stays outside; use it to gate rewards, not entry.
